r2_patient_aggregation: equal mean over retained posterior cervical/middle/fundal regions
missing_policy: leave blank/NaN; never replace with zero
case_id_policy: preserve as string from manifest through all R2/longitudinal joins
manifest_path_policy: relative paths resolved against the manifest directory before processing
r2_case_failure_policy: isolate failed or invalid R2 cases; retain final row with NaN and status/failure reason; do not abort successful cases
source_hash_policy: canonical LF text hashing plus repository .gitattributes eol=lf
r2_partial_failure_merge_policy: merge successful cases only; failed cases retained as status/reason and never indexed from outputs
r2_cache_temp_policy: temporary cache files do not end in .npz and are excluded from trajectory-cache discovery
